metric_contract.source: Phase118/120 truth-only contract and pinned Phase82/Phase76 scorer; no semantic change
metric_contract.truth_reader: CSV DictReader over required field names; optional columns allowed
metric_contract.truth_phone_policy: optional phone must equal declared route; absent phone is assigned the declared route
metric_contract.duplicate_policy: duplicate prediction or truth keys fail closed
metric_contract.extra_prediction_policy: prediction keys absent from truth fail closed
metric_contract.prediction_domain_coverage: matched prediction keys / prediction keys; required exactly 1.0
metric_contract.truth_row_coverage: informational only; pinned warm-up exclusion is enforced
metric_contract.missing_truth_policy: only the exact pinned leading warm-up truth key may be absent; no interpolation, nearest, edge hold, extrapolation, or fill
metric_contract.macro: unweighted arithmetic mean over exactly MTV-A then LAX-T
metric_contract.continuity: prediction Haversine transition speed; over_70_mps_count must equal 0
metric_contract.finite_and_earth_valid: all candidate coordinates and derived metric values finite; latitude in [-90,90] and longitude in [-180,180]
